_comments.backend.host: Backend server host. Use 127.0.0.1 for local dev
_comments.backend.provider_base_urls: Base URLs for each supported model provider
_comments.backend.safety_strict_mode: Safety: true = refuse age-inappropriate content, false = rewrite it instead
_comments.backend.log_level: Logging verbosity: DEBUG | INFO | WARNING | ERROR
_comments.backend.http_log_skip_path_prefixes: Comma-separated URL prefixes to skip from HTTP logs. e.g. /audio/,/health/
_comments.backend.hf_hub_disable_progress_bars: HuggingFace: 1 = hide download progress bars, 0 = show them
_comments.backend.transformers_verbosity: HuggingFace Transformers log level: debug | info | warning | error
_comments.backend.cors_origins: Allowed frontend origins. Add production URL here when deploying e.g. https://myapp.com
_comments.backend.cors_credentials: Allow cookies/auth headers in CORS. Must be true when cors_origins is not *
_comments.backend.cors_methods: Allowed HTTP methods for CORS requests
_comments.backend.cors_expose_headers: Response headers the frontend JS can read
_comments.frontend.chat_retention_hours: Hours to keep chat history in browser. 0 = no retention
